title: Reduced generic-fibre field embedding
statement: Let Z, S and S-prime be affine schemes in universe u, with S-prime integral. Let g: Z to S and q: S-prime to S be morphisms, eta in S, and eta-prime a generic point of S-prime mapping to eta. Let L, k-prime and E be fields in universe u with algebra structures kappa(eta) to L, kappa(eta) to k-prime, L to E and k-prime to E. Assume k-prime/kappa(eta) is finite purely inseparable and the two composites kappa(eta) to E coincide. Suppose j: Spec L to the eta fibre of g is scheme-theoretically dominant and its base composite is Spec of the algebra map. Suppose a ring equivalence e: kappa(eta-prime) to k-prime identifies the q residue field map with the specified base extension. If E/k-prime is separably generated, then E admits a kappa(eta-prime)-algebra structure and a scheme-theoretically dominant map h: Spec E to the eta-prime fibre of the canonical reduction of Z times_S S-prime. The extension E/kappa(eta-prime) is separably generated, and h followed by the reduced fibre projection equals Spec of its algebra map. No base scheme, field, or purely inseparable extension is constructed by this theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_reduced_generic_fibre_field_embedding
    {Z S S' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Z] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S'] [IsIntegral S']
    (g : Z ⟶ S) (q : S' ⟶ S) (η : S) (η' : S') (hq : q η' = η)
    (hη' : IsGenericPoint η' Set.univ)
    (L k' E : Type u) [Field L] [Field k'] [Field E]
    [Algebra (S.residueField η) L] [Algebra (S.residueField η) k']
    [Algebra L E] [Algebra k' E]
    [Module.Finite (S.residueField η) k'] [IsPurelyInseparable (S.residueField η) k']
    (j : Spec (.of L) ⟶ g.fiber η) (hj : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant j)
    (hjbase : j ≫ g.fiberToSpecResidueField η =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) L)))
    (e : S'.residueField η' ≃+* k')
    (he : e.toRingHom.comp
      (((S.residueFieldCongr hq).inv ≫ q.residueFieldMap η').hom) =
        algebraMap (S.residueField η) k')
    (hsquare : (algebraMap k' E).comp (algebraMap (S.residueField η) k') =
      (algebraMap L E).comp (algebraMap (S.residueField η) L))
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparablyGenerated k' E) :
    ∃ aE : Algebra (S'.residueField η') E,
      letI := aE
      ∃ h : Spec (.of E) ⟶
          ((pullback g q).nilradical.subschemeι ≫ pullback.snd g q).fiber η',
        IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant h ∧
        Algebra.IsSeparablyGenerated (S'.residueField η') E ∧
        h ≫ ((pullback g q).nilradical.subschemeι ≫
          pullback.snd g q).fiberToSpecResidueField η' =
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S'.residueField η') E))

proof.text: Apply the core affine construction to obtain the compatible algebra on E, dominant field map and base identity. Transport the separably generated extension along e using the returned algebra-map compatibility, and assemble the three conclusions.
